repaired_answer: Highly ionizing monopoles lose energy before reaching the calorimeter, so the search used forward-neutron and pixel-cluster triggers. Ionized gas time-broadens pulsar pulses at standard radio frequencies, so the survey observed at 8–12 GHz where scattering is weaker.
ablation_rationale: Each document is necessary for one explicitly comparable failure-mechanism/mitigation pair; neither document can answer the other search case.
